comment: The booth on Larak Lot: a watcher's panel of power pads, the Custody Plate and runs from the server's spectator-only facts; the director cutting the follow camera; nameplates with Silkscreen callsigns, the true behaviour chip and a pixel health bar that geometry never cuts; the Tab board with rank, callsign, frags, deaths and ping, watched and then joined. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP=1 FRAGR_QA_BOTS=6 FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/booth.json. Presentation only; no player pose injection.

states.name: booth_follow
states.note: A watched fight with the booth panel down the left: pad clocks counting, the Plate and any run.

states.name: booth_overview_plates
states.note: The overview that bit callsigns in half under the decks: whole plates over pixel health bars.

states.name: booth_director
states.note: Four seconds of the follow camera under the director; the manifest names its last cut.

states.name: booth_eye
states.note: Through a fighter's eyes with the panel and the feed's kill glyphs.

states.name: booth_board
states.note: The Tab board for a watcher: rank, callsign and chip, frags, deaths, ping.

states.name: booth_joined_board
states.note: Joined: the board marks the fighter's own row and its measured ping; the booth panel is gone.
